npm CLI adapter usage

Version:
  tools run vendor.npm -- --version

List package scripts:
  tools run vendor.npm -- run

Install dependencies:
  tools run vendor.npm -- install

Clean install from lockfile:
  tools run vendor.npm -- ci

Build:
  tools run vendor.npm -- run build

Typecheck if present:
  tools run vendor.npm -- run typecheck --if-present

Lint if present:
  tools run vendor.npm -- run lint --if-present

Test if present:
  tools run vendor.npm -- run test --if-present

Dev server if present:
  tools run vendor.npm -- run dev --if-present

Preview server if present:
  tools run vendor.npm -- run preview --if-present
